source: Six learning exchanges saved as one batch
lessonTheme: Recalling comprendemos, qué questions and necesitamos
summary: Correctly recalled comprendemos in a full sentence. Practised qué versus por qué and combined a what question with purpose. One question used leer rather than requested aprender; a shorter answer was grammatical but omitted the requested language. Introduced necesitamos + infinitive; after reviser and omitted lo were corrected, correctly produced Necesitamos publicarlo.

observations.outcome: Correct comprendemos with the full stem, leemos and reason structure, without a verb-form hint in the immediate prompt. Supplied ñ. This is short-gap recall after earlier correction, not a timed long-term retention test. Tutor then introduced qué questions contrasted with por qué.
Grammatical question meaning What do we want to read? The requested meaning was learn, so tutor supplied ¿Qué queremos aprender?. Supplied question accent and punctuation; word order was correct.
Valid sentence meaning We want to learn. It omitted español from the requested full meaning; tutor supplied Queremos aprender español without treating the shorter version as ungrammatical.
Correct question structure and para + infinitive. Supplied accents, lowercase para and question punctuation. Tutor then introduced Necesitamos... and modelled Necesitamos leer.
Necesitamos was correct. Corrected revisar to its -ar ending and supplied lo for the requested object it, reinforcing revisar + lo.
Correct complete sentence after the prior model and correction; no publish-it form was supplied in the immediate prompt. Delayed retention remains untested.

nextSteps: Combine no with necesitamos without adding new vocabulary
Revisit revisar versus reviser and retain the requested object pronoun
Recheck qué versus por qué and leer versus aprender after a gap
Recheck comprendemos and queremos later in new contexts
assessmentNote: Correct short-gap recall and immediate transfer are distinguished from spelling corrections, a translation mismatch and a valid shortened answer.
